title: XKCD Simple Writer Word List
author: Randall Munroe / xkcd
extraction: Extract the literal window.__WORDS string, split at |, sort, and write one entry per line in UTF-8 with a final LF. Preserve every entry including curly apostrophe variants. No additions or omissions.
scope: Official expanded spelling list for the Thing Explainer ten-hundred-word vocabulary, not 3,634 separate root words and not a reconstructed ranked list of 1,000 roots. Munroe states that word forms usually count together and that he combined multiple frequency-counting methods.
checker_policy: Accept only exact list membership after lowercase and curly-to-straight apostrophe normalization. Split hyphenated phrases into words. Do not reproduce the online editor apostrophe-suffix bypass. Ignore only nonvisible HTTPS/HTTP Markdown link destinations. Check all labels, headings, and ordinary text. Spell numbers out; reject other visible symbols outside the documented punctuation set.
